name: Parking Fine Payment Confirmation
description: Confirmation email sent when a student pays a parking fine
subject: Payment Confirmation - Parking Fine #{fine_id}
body_html:
Payment Confirmation

Dear {student_name},

Thank you for your payment. This confirms that your parking fine has been paid.

Payment Details

Fine ID:#{fine_id}
Amount Paid:£{amount}
Payment Method:{payment_method}
Payment Date:{payment_date}
Confirmation Number:{payment_id}

Your parking record has been updated, and no further action is required.

If you have any questions, please contact the Parking Management Office.

Best regards,
Parking Management

student_name.description: Name of the student who paid the fine

fine_id.description: Unique identifier for the parking fine

payment_method.description: Method of payment (e.g., Card, Cash, Bank Transfer)
